title: Executive powers and functions of the Secretary

versions.1994:
47. Executive powers and functions of the Secretary.— (1) The Secretary shall perform such duties and exercise such administrative powers as may be assigned to him under this Act or rules made thereunder.
(2) He shall attend meetings of the Panchayat, record minutes, and manage local files under the general direction of the Sarpanch.

history.details: Completely substituted Section 47 to expand the Secretary's autonomous executive role. Granted explicit signature authority to issue building licenses, execute panchayat resolutions, and initiate demolition proceedings for illegal structures.
Inserted sub-section (i-a) to bypass licensing delays: BDO is authorized to issue trade licenses if the Secretary fails to execute a passed resolution within 30 days.
